label: causal and temporal clauses: because, and when
note: tarhi ('then, in that case') and yathā ('as, in the way that') are the two correlative adverbs the track teaches, both in chapter 49. Their partners — yadi, yadā, yasmāt — are not, so a learner has the second half of each pair and not the first. Counted covered on the exponents, and the note is the work item.
